content.value: Water flows under a sluice gate on a horizontal $\mathrm { \dot { b } e \dot { d } }$ at the inlet to a flume. Upstream from the gate, the water depth is 0.5 m and the speed negligible. At the vena contracta downstream from the gate, the flow streamlines are straight and the depth is 50 mm. Determine the flow speed downstream from the gate and the discharge per unit width of the gate.

_source_title: B.Sc. Engineering 2nd Year 1st Term Regular Examination, 2017
